# Scaling Outbound With Signals

Teams that layer **intent signals** on top of firmographics see higher reply rates. This post explains intent data and how to use it.

## Why signals matter

  * Timing beats volume
  * Context improves _relevance_
  * Signals compound over time

The chart above shows reply rate by signal count.

Signals| Reply rate  
---|---  
0| 1.2%  
3| 4.8%
